title: AgentLeak: privacy-leakage testing for agentic AI systems
description: AgentLeak audits complete AI-agent execution traces for privacy leakage across eight channels. Version 0.11.8 bundles 266 scenarios with complete source, license and corrected publication-attribution metadata and supports deterministic, NER-assisted and semantic detection tiers.
notes: Release 0.11.8 restores Godwin Badu-Marfo in every attribution of the published IEEE Access article. Software authorship remains El Yagoubi, Quintero and Al Mallah. Runtime behavior and the 266-scenario corpus are unchanged from v0.11.7.
